actions.action: Inspect plants with a flashlight 1-2 hours after dark
Look for slime trails and frass on leaves and pot rim
Check under pots and in drainage trays for snails/slugs
Inspect leaf undersides and stem joints for other pests
Remove pests by hand or relocate them
If slugs/snails, apply copper tape barrier
If slugs/snails, use iron phosphate bait (alternative)
Move plants off the floor or away from window ledge/balcony edge
Keep pets away from plants if they are the cause
Water only after top 2-3 inches of soil dry out

reason: The answer gets the chewing-pest part of the diagnosis but misses low humidity entirely and never suggests raising humidity, which was the fix; its pest advice is unlikely to make the plant worse.
